annotations.title: Income and savings needed to buy a home at a price

description: Gives the net monthly income and savings needed to buy a home at a price in Portugal under the Banco de Portugal rules. Use it for affordability; for purchase taxes, `imt_calculate`.

price.description: Price of the home in euros; a dot or a space may group thousands (250.000). Fixed scenario: buyer aged 30, own permanent home, 40-year loan, 10 % deposit, IMT Jovem, market rate

territory.description: Mainland Portugal (continente) or the Azores and Madeira (regioes_autonomas), which have their own IMT tables

name: required_income

min_net_monthly_income_cents.description: Euro cents: minimum NET monthly income of the borrowers

savings_needed_cents.description: Euro cents: deposit, taxes, registration, loan stamp

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Income and savings needed to buy a home at a price
